native.unit: $ per DALY averted (mean of seven countries)

clear-solutions-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate for a new charity scaling up co-packaged oral rehydration salts and zinc for children with diarrhoea, delivered through community health workers in seven African countries. The idea Clear Solutions was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line (the mean cost per DALY across the seven countries).

native.unit: $ per DALY equivalent (point estimate, average Sub-Saharan African country)

lead-exposure-elimination-project-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate for a new charity advocating for lead paint regulation in a typical Sub-Saharan African country, counting health and income gains from lower childhood lead exposure. The idea the Lead Exposure Elimination Project was founded to run. A re-implementation of the sheet's point-estimate tab ($204 per DALY equivalent); the report's headline of about $156 is the mean of a Monte Carlo simulation whose draws are pasted into the sheet.

native.unit: $ per DALY equivalent (West Africa, final result)

lead-research-for-action-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2024 estimate for a new charity running studies on sources of lead exposure in low- and middle-income countries, so governments and others can act on them, modelled for West Africa. The idea Lead Research for Action was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its final cost per DALY equivalent.

native.unit: $ per DALY equivalent (Thailand, final result)

labri-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 estimate for a new charity advocating for regulation of used lead-acid battery recycling, modelled for Thailand, counting health and income gains from lower lead exposure. The idea LABRI (Lead-Acid Battery Recycling Initiative) was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet as it stands today, traced from its final cost per DALY equivalent; the published report gave about $42 per DALY ($17 per income doubling) from an earlier version.

native.unit: $ per DALY averted, charity and government costs (rear-seat seat belt law, Egypt)

radius-institute-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2022 estimate for a new charity advocating for road safety laws, here a law requiring rear-seat passengers in Egypt to wear seat belts, the first of the legislative asks the report costs. The idea the Radius Institute for Road Safety was founded to run. A re-implementation of that tab of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its cost per DALY counting the charity's and the government's costs ($90, the report's figure).

native.unit: $ per DALY equivalent, charity costs (Germany's GIZ adopts cash benchmarking, expected case)

centre-for-effective-aid-policy-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2022 estimate for a new charity advocating for more cost-effective aid, modelled as Germany's development agency GIZ adopting cash benchmarking. The idea the Centre for Effective Aid Policy was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its expected-case cost per DALY equivalent.

native.unit: $ per DALY averted, charity and government costs (Ghana)

healthy-futures-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate for a new charity that helps governments roll out dual HIV/syphilis rapid tests and penicillin treatment in antenatal clinics, modelled for Ghana. The idea Healthy Futures was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: the cost per DALY averted counting both charity and government costs (the current sheet gives $92; the report quoted $81).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (four-hospital program, Pakistan)

ansh-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate for a new charity that embeds kangaroo care for low birth weight babies in existing hospitals, modelled for four hospitals in Pakistan. The idea Ansh was founded to run (Ansh went on to work in India). A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: the cost per DALY averted of the four-hospital program (about $98).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Pakistan)

first-embrace-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 update of its estimate for a new charity scaling up kangaroo care for low birth weight babies by embedding it in hospitals, modelled for Pakistan. The idea First Embrace was founded to run (First Embrace works in Nigeria). A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: the final cost per DALY averted per successful charity (about $50).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Nigeria, 2024 updated CEA)

oxygen-access-project-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's estimate for a new charity that distributes and maintains oxygen concentrators and pulse oximeters so hospitals can treat childhood pneumonia, modelled for Nigeria. The idea Oxygen Access Project was founded to run. A re-implementation of the 2024 updated CEA in AIM's spreadsheet, which AIM marks as superseding the 2023 report's model, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: about $173 per DALY averted (the 2023 report quoted $38 to $79).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Burkina Faso, children under 5)

spiro-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate for a new charity that visits the households of people with tuberculosis to screen child contacts and start treatment or preventive therapy. The idea Spiro was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line for the report's first scenario: children under five in Burkina Faso, about $126 per DALY averted.

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Sierra Leone, including under-5 benefits)

opal-health-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2024 estimate for a new charity that trains community workers to run participatory learning and action groups for pregnant women and mothers, cutting maternal, newborn and child deaths, modelled for Sierra Leone. The idea Opal Health was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet as corrected in August 2024, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: about $56 per DALY averted.

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Nepal, myCOPD partnership model)

respira-health-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's estimate for a new charity that partners with a digital app to give pulmonary rehabilitation to people recently hospitalised with COPD, modelled for Nepal. The idea Respira Health was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line: about $84 per DALY averted (the report's range is $9 to $84 across countries).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (over the charity's life)

maternal-health-initiative-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate for a new charity adding family planning counselling and contraception to the care women get in the year after giving birth. The idea Maternal Health Initiative was founded to run. Its bottom line is the cost per DALY averted over the charity's life, counting health benefits of fewer unintended pregnancies (unsafe abortion, anaemia, obstructed labour, postpartum depression).

native.unit: $ per QALY gained (scenario 2: low-income country, new workbooks, paid telephone support)

kaya-guides-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate for a new charity offering guided self-help for depression: a workbook plus short phone support from lay workers. The idea Kaya Guides was founded to run. Its bottom line is the total cost per QALY gained in the report's most likely low-income-country scenario, with counterfactual costs; we read a QALY gained as a DALY averted.

native.unit: years of doubled consumption per $1,000 (Nepal, no added migration, $50 user fee)

rahi-impact-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2024 estimate for a new charity running a digital platform that matches workers in Nepal with vetted overseas employers, cutting recruitment fees and fraud. The idea Rahi Impact was founded to run. Its bottom line is years of doubled consumption per $1,000 in the Nepal scenario without any added migration; AIM's report states the same result in DALY-equivalents.

native.unit: $ per year of doubled consumption (Kenya)

better-season-project-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's estimate (2026 idea report) for a new charity helping smallholder farmers in Kenya get low-risk loans secured on the asset they buy, such as a water tank. The idea Better Season Project was founded to run. Its bottom line is the cost per year of doubled household consumption, including the chance the charity fails.

native.unit: years of doubled consumption per $1,000 (expected, with 56% chance of success)

better-futures-guide-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 estimate for a new evaluator that finds and recommends highly cost-effective livelihoods charities, moving donors' money to them. The idea Better Futures Guide was founded to run. Its bottom line is the years of doubled consumption per $1,000 of the evaluator's costs, from new and shifted donations, weighted by its chance of success.

native.unit: $ per DALY averted, charity and government costs (50% tobacco excise increase, Mongolia)

concentric-policies-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2022 estimate for a new charity advocating for higher tobacco taxes, here a 50% rise in Mongolia's tobacco excise, the first of the four country-and-ask tabs the report costs. The idea Concentric Policies was founded to run. A re-implementation of that tab of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its cost per DALY counting the charity's and the government's costs ($51; the report's range, $39 to $51, is this tab's charity-only and charity-plus-government figures).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted, charity and government costs (advocacy for the US PASTEUR Act and similar pull incentives elsewhere)

alliance-for-reducing-microbial-resistan.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate for a new charity advocating for subscription-style pull incentives (the US PASTEUR Act, and similar schemes in other rich countries) that pay for new antibiotics against drug-resistant infections. The idea ARMoR was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet as it stands today, traced from its cost per DALY counting the charity's and governments' costs ($110); the report gave $90.80 from an earlier version, and $0.10 counting the charity's costs alone.

native.unit: $ per DALY averted, charity and other costs (Angola)

notify-health-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate for a new charity sending SMS and voice reminders to caregivers so more children complete their vaccinations, modelled for Angola. The idea Notify Health was founded to run. A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its cost per DALY counting the charity's costs and the health system's and families' costs ($78; $39 counting the charity's costs alone).

native.unit: $ per DALY equivalent (point-estimate tab, average Sub-Saharan African country; the report's $96 is the mean of a Monte Carlo run)

center-for-alcohol-policy-solutions-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate for a new charity advocating for a 50% rise in alcohol excise taxes in an average Sub-Saharan African country, counting health and income gains from lower drinking. The idea the Center for Alcohol Policy Solutions was founded to run. A re-implementation of the sheet's point-estimate tab ($98 per DALY equivalent); the report's headline, about $96 (a benefit-cost ratio of 115:1), is the mean of a Monte Carlo simulation.

native.unit: $ per income doubling (Philippines, final result)

foundations-first-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 estimate for a new charity scaling up Teaching at the Right Level (grouping primary pupils by learning level rather than grade) in the Philippines, counting the higher lifetime earnings that better test scores bring. The idea Foundations First was founded to run (AIM's 2026 cohort, working in Kenya). A re-implementation of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its final cost per income doubling ($45; the report's range is $12–45).

native.unit: $ per DALY averted (Uttar Pradesh, India, final result)

neev-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2025 estimate for a new charity training brick kiln owners and operators in northern India to run zigzag kilns more efficiently, cutting the fine particles and sulphur dioxide that harm people's health. The idea Neev was founded to run (AIM's 2026 cohort). A re-implementation of the health tab of AIM's spreadsheet, traced from its final cost per DALY averted in Uttar Pradesh ($315); the climate benefit AIM estimates on a separate tab (about $2 per tonne of CO2) is left out, so the result counts health only.

native.unit: $ per QALY (after funding and staff counterfactuals)

fortify-health-aim.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate of Fortify Health's wheat flour fortification in India, made for its mental health research: iron lowers anaemia, and with it the risk of depression, anxiety and other psychiatric and developmental conditions, plus anaemia's own disability and a small gain in earnings. Fortify Health was AIM's first incubated charity (2017); this is AIM's own model of its program, beside GiveWell's. A re-implementation of AIM's sheet, traced from its cost per QALY after subtracting the good the money and staff would have done elsewhere ($546; $91 before that subtraction).

native.unit: $ per DALY equivalent (all inputs at expected values)

centre-for-effective-aid-policy-aim-2020.summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate for a new charity persuading Germany to move part of its bilateral aid from upper-middle- to low-income countries, counting the extra income the money produces where it goes further. An earlier AIM model of the aid-quality idea area the Centre for Effective Aid Policy was later founded (from AIM's 2022 report) to work in. A hand re-implementation at expected values, about $392 per DALY equivalent; AIM's headline, $288 (a benefit-cost ratio of 38), is the mean of 1,000 simulations pasted into the sheet and is kept as a reference row.
